question: Which additional yoginī embodiments are included among those known through devotion on earth?
premises: The verse continues an enumerated list of yoginī forms.
Disjunctive particles present alternative named embodiments.
The concluding adverb marks these forms as included in the same series.
inference: Further yoginī embodiments are enumerated as part of those known through devotion.
uncertainties: The precise identities or characteristics of pecakī, sararī, and gūlī are not specified in this verse.
plain_english: Or the owl-woman, or indeed the peacock-woman, or the sararī-woman, or likewise the gūlī-woman.
